theorem.finite_algebras: A_m=C(C_m) tensor M_125, with the declared identity tails when present; every A_m is a finite direct sum of full matrix algebras.
theorem.embeddings: The child-constant pullbacks and identity-tail maps are injective unital star homomorphisms j_m:A_m->A_(m+1).
theorem.limit: The norm closure of the algebraic direct limit is a uniquely defined AF/quasi-local C-star algebra A_infinity.
theorem.dynamics: The Heisenberg adjoints of the finite CPTP channels are compatible UCP maps. Naturality Phi_(m+1,t) j_m=j_m Phi_(m,t) defines one UCP map Phi_(infinity,t) on the algebraic union.
theorem.uniform_bound: Every unital positive map between C-star algebras is operator-norm contractive, and every UCP map is completely contractive; hence ||Phi_(infinity,t)||_cb=1 for all t and all refinement depths.
theorem.time_continuity: BGCE336R2 operator-norm convergence on every finite stage plus the common contractive bound and density of the algebraic union imply strong continuity of t->Phi_(infinity,t).
theorem.ward_extension: The BGCE350 telescope is compatible with j_m and therefore defines the same cylinder-local Ward functional on the dense local subalgebra.

counter_intuition_scan.strongest_counter_pattern: A norm-one channel can coexist with divergent composite observables, an unbounded generator, or absent spatial-gradient dynamics; channel boundedness alone is not perturbative renormalizability or physical UV completeness.
counter_intuition_scan.ordinary_explanation: Compatible UCP maps on an AF inductive system extend contractively by standard C-star completion.
counter_intuition_scan.falsifier: A noninjective or non-star refinement map, failure of channel intertwining at any stage, loss of complete positivity or unitality in the Heisenberg adjoint, or a retained observable that is not a compatible local-algebra element.

claim_ceiling: BGCE445 proves a nonperturbative all-refinement-depth existence and uniform complete-contraction theorem only for the BGCE349 block-local aligned source-cylinder CPTP parent and its local Ward observables. It does not prove a bounded limit generator, nontrivial spatial-gradient field dynamics, actual UB612 quartic coefficient generation, smooth-spacetime renormalizability, ultraviolet completeness of full quantum gravity, empirical gravity, RPD adoption, or Official SIEL adoption.
